require 'sinatra'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'

module AuthHelper
  SESSIONS = {}
  USERS = {
    'admin' => { password: BCrypt::Password.create('admin_pass_2024!'), role: 'admin' },
    'analyst' => { password: BCrypt::Password.create('analyst_pass!'), role: 'analyst' },
    'viewer' => { password: BCrypt::Password.create('viewer_pass!'), role: 'viewer' }
  }

  ROLE_PERMISSIONS = {
    'admin' => [:read, :write, :delete, :import, :export, :manage_users],
    'analyst' => [:read, :write, :import, :export],
    'viewer' => [:read, :export]
  }

  def self.authenticate(username, password)
    user = USERS[username]
    return nil unless user
    return nil unless BCrypt::Password.new(user[:password]) == password
    token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    SESSIONS[token] = { username: username, role: user[:role], created_at: Time.now }
    token
  end

  def self.authorize(token, permission)
    session = SESSIONS[token]
    return false unless session
    return false if Time.now - session[:created_at] > 3600
    ROLE_PERMISSIONS[session[:role]]&.include?(permission)
  end

  def self.get_session(token)
    SESSIONS[token]
  end
end

module XMLProcessor
  SAFE_PARSE_OPTIONS = Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::NONET
  FULL_PARSE_OPTIONS = Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::DEFAULT_XML

  def self.parser_options_for_role(role)
    case role
    when 'admin'
      # Admins may need to process complex XML with DTDs for integration
      FULL_PARSE_OPTIONS
    when 'analyst'
      # Analysts get standard parsing for report imports
      parse_options_standard
    when 'viewer'
      SAFE_PARSE_OPTIONS
    else
      SAFE_PARSE_OPTIONS
    end
  end

  def self.parse_options_standard
    # Standard options: enable substitution for entity references in documents
    Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::DTDLOAD | Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::NOENT
  end

  def self.parse_document(xml_content, role)
    options = parser_options_for_role(role)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content) do |config|
      config.options = options
    end
    doc
  end

  def self.extract_report_data(doc)
    reports = []
    doc.xpath('//report').each do |node|
      reports << {
        title: node.at_xpath('title')&.text,
        summary: node.at_xpath('summary')&.text,
        date: node.at_xpath('date')&.text,
        author: node.at_xpath('author')&.text
      }
    end
    reports
  end
end

class ReportApp < Sinatra::Base
  use Rack::Session::Cookie, secret: SecureRandom.hex(64)

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  post '/login' do
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    token = AuthHelper.authenticate(data['username'], data['password'])
    if token
      { status: 'ok', token: token }.to_json
    else
      halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json
    end
  end

  post '/import/reports' do
    token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub('Bearer ', '')
    halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless token

    session_data = AuthHelper.get_session(token)
    halt 401, { error: 'Session expired' }.to_json unless session_data

    unless AuthHelper.authorize(token, :import)
      halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden: insufficient permissions' }.to_json
    end

    xml_body = request.body.read
    halt 400, { error: 'Empty body' }.to_json if xml_body.nil? || xml_body.empty?

    # Size limit to prevent DoS
    halt 413, { error: 'Payload too large' }.to_json if xml_body.bytesize > 1_048_576

    begin
      doc = XMLProcessor.parse_document(xml_body, session_data[:role])
      reports = XMLProcessor.extract_report_data(doc)
      { status: 'imported', count: reports.length, reports: reports }.to_json
    rescue Nokogiri::XML::SyntaxError => e
      halt 422, { error: 'Invalid XML', details: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end

  get '/reports' do
    token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub('Bearer ', '')
    halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless token
    unless AuthHelper.authorize(token, :read)
      halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json
    end
    { reports: [] }.to_json
  end
end
